pages.text: A bucket of milk left seven days in a kiln, somewhere dark, comes out a $(item)Cheese Wheel$(). The days only count while no light reaches it.$(br2)Place the wheel and eat it a wedge at a time.

Cooked cod and salmon cure in three days and keep you fed longer than fresh fish.$(br2)With other mods installed there is more to cure: hydra chops, gwiblings, dweller steaks, phantom and turtle meat. JEI shows every recipe and its days.
pages.title: Cured Foods
